capabilities: set a checkbox to in-progress [/] with Shift+Click
cycle checkbox states between unchecked, in-progress, and completed on click
work in both Reading view and Live Preview
extras: The manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian checkboxes only toggle between unchecked and completed, with no built-in in-progress state.
summary: Task checkbox plugin that adds an in-progress [/] state via Shift+Click and cycles checkbox states on click.
